name: Urban arterial corridor upgrade — UK Stage 2 with intentional issues

metadata.name: Millbrook Corridor Upgrade
metadata.description: Duplication of a 1.2 km urban arterial section with two new signalised junctions.
metadata.scheme_summary: Widening to dual carriageway; new signals at School Lane and Depot Road; shared-use footway/cycleway on north side.

scheme_description_objectives.value: Corridor duplication to relieve congestion; objectives include improved bus journey times.

design_standards_applied.value: DMRB CD 109, CD 123, LTN 1/20 for the cycleway.

design_speeds_and_speed_limits.value: Design speed 60 km/h; proposed limit 30 mph.

vru_desire_lines.value: Strong school desire line crossing Depot Road; commuter cycling along corridor.

collision_data_analysis_36mo.value: 36-month STATS19 extract: 4 slight injury collisions, cluster at Depot Road junction (rear-end shunts).

notes: Intentional defect: Stage 1 response reports not provided although a Stage 1 audit occurred -> process gap must surface. All other required inputs provided.
